photo.summary: This image shows a close-up view of the front left side of a blue car. The car has a noticeable dent on the bumper near the headlight. The headlight is partially visible, showing the clear lens and the housing. The front wheel is also visible, featuring a silver alloy rim with a hubcap displaying the Volkswagen logo. The car is parked on a paved surface with white markings.
